description: Apply a policy change you proposed (propose_policy_change, create_policy, rollback_policy) by its proposalId. Only call this after showing the user the proposal's change list and getting their explicit approval in this conversation. A HIGH impact proposal can't be applied here: a person approves it in the Nomid portal, so give the user its approvalUrl, and get_policy_proposal then shows the outcome. Fails without changing anything if the proposal expired, was already applied, or the policy was changed since it was proposed (stale_proposal: read it again and propose again).

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

confirmation.description: Ignored: Nomid no longer asks for a typed policy name.

proposalId.description: The proposalId returned by propose_policy_change, create_policy or rollback_policy.

name: apply_policy_proposal
title: Apply a policy change proposal
